m.pg: Money making guide/Smithing elder rune shields
m.h:
Use any anvil to forge elder rune bars into shields. Noted elder rune bars can be added to the metal bank and then withdrawn. You can queue up smithing multiple shields by right clicking the anvil, choosing "open smithing interface" and selecting elder rune shields until you have a full inventory of unfinished smithing items. You will then start to smith the shields, automatically starting to smith the next unfinished item as each is completed. Maintain high heat by using a forge to progress in creating shields at the fastest rate.

If owned, it is recommended to use an orthen furnace core and Superheat Form to maintain high heat and produce shields faster. This requires completion of The Light Within and level 99 Smithing and 102 Archaeology to create the orthen furnace core. In one hour you can make about 32-33 shields using this method.

Glorious bars are used in the creation of masterwork equipment. This method involves creating glorious bars from scratch, which can be done at any anvil except the anvil in Ashdale:

  1. Create 50 concentrated alloy bars using 1 of each of the bars listed above per alloy bar.
  2. Use the concentrated alloy bars to create 10 enriched alloy bars
  3. Use the enriched alloy bars to create 1 immaculate alloy bar
  4. Start folding the immaculate alloy bar into a glorious bar. A partially folded alloy bar must be folded 1,001 times to produce. It takes about 2,004 ticks, or 20 minutes, to produce one glorious bar.

m.h:
You can make money by smithing mithril bars and maple logs into mithril spears at the barbarian anvil at Gunnarsgrunn (the Barbarian Village). It is recommended, in order to reach maximum profit, to deposit all the mithril bars into your metal bank before starting, and then set up a bank preset with 26 maple logs and your wilderness sword (with the skull sceptre equipped). Bind your scepter and your sword on your action bar. If banking using a teleport item that isn't equipped in the weapon or shield slot, 27 logs can be brought at a time instead. Memory strands are a useful option, as they can be stored in the currency pouch.

After loading your preset, teleport to Gunnarsgrunn by pressing the scepter keybind. Run to the barbarian anvil close north to where you appear, while equiping your wilderness sword, either from inventory or by pressing its keybind. Smith your 26 or 27 spears at the anvil and press the sword keybind to teleport close to the Edgeville bank. Run to the bank while equipping the scepter. Load bank preset, and repeat.

You can replace the wilderness sword with any item allowing for fast teleportation to a bank.

You should be able to smith one inventory every 11.5 minutes, making about 140 Mithril spears an hour.

Use any anvil to forge rune bars into arrowheads. Noted rune bars can be added to the metal bank and then withdrawn, as rune arrowheads are stackable there is no need to bank. You can queue up smithing multiple sets of rune arrowheads by right clicking the anvil, choosing "open smithing interface" and selecting rune arrowheads until you have a full inventory of unfinished smithing items. You will then start to smith the arrowheads, automatically starting to smith the next unfinished item as each is completed. Maintain high heat by using a forge to progress in creating arrowheads at the fastest rate.

Although smithing rune arrowheads only requires level 50 Smithing, level 59 Smithing is recommended in order to create each unfinished smithing item with the highest possible heat available, maximising the number of arrowheads smithed per hour.

Use any anvil to forge rune bars into rune bolts (unf). Noted rune bars can be added to the metal bank and then withdrawn, as rune bolts (unf) are stackable there is no need to bank. You can queue up smithing multiple sets of rune bolts (unf) by right clicking the anvil, choosing "open smithing interface" and selecting rune bolts (unf) until you have a full inventory of unfinished smithing items. You will then start to smith the bolts, automatically starting to smith the next unfinished item as each is completed. Maintain high heat by using a forge to progress in creating bolts at the fastest rate.

Although smithing rune bolts (unf) only requires level 50 Smithing, level 59 Smithing is recommended in order to create each unfinished smithing item with the highest possible heat available, maximising the number of bolts smithed per hour.

The best method for free-to-play players is to use the spinning wheel on the of Lumbridge Castle, and to bank on the . You should use a preset with flax in your inventory to speed up the process. Alternative, if you pick the flax yourself in Taverly, use the spinning wheel just north, near Jack Oval and bank in Burthorpe.

In members the closest spinning wheel to a bank is in Neitiznot, which requires completion of The Fremennik Isles to access. Another good option is Seers' Village if you have completed the medium Seers' Village achievements. You can then equip the Seer's headband 2, which has the benefit of spinning the flax 33% faster. If the Ranger's Workroom is constructed in Fort Forinthry, this unlocks a spinning wheel with a bank chest right beside it.
This method assumes that an inventory of 25 flax is spun every 10 seconds. It is highly recommended that you make a bank preset with 25 flax, 5 astral runes, and 10 nature runes.

m.t: Spinning starbloom cloth from starbloom flowers
m.pg: Money making guide/Spinning starbloom flowers into cloth
m.h:
First, spin starbloom flower into starbloom thread at a spinning wheel.

The spinning wheel in the Ranger's Workroom (at least tier 1) in Fort Forinthry is right next to a bank, so it's an optimal location for this.

Next, weave starbloom thread into starbloom cloth at any loom.

Both starbloom thread and starbloom cloth are stackable, so it's wise to process all of your starbloom flower into starbloom thread first, and then process all of that starbloom thread into starbloom cloth at once.

The best possible method is to use the spinning wheel on the of Lumbridge Castle, and to bank on the . A full load of 28 wool takes approximately 50 seconds to convert into balls of wool. Travel and banking time is ~20 seconds in between loads. You should use a preset with wool in your inventory to speed up the process.

m.pg: Money making guide/Stealing cave goblin wire
m.h: The wire machine can be found in the south-west area of the city, east of a furnace. The wire respawns in 6 seconds after being taken. One trip of 28 wires takes about 5 minutes. It is possible to achieve higher profits (and additional Magic experience) by casting High Level Alchemy on a noted stack of any profitable item while waiting for the wire to spawn. Several casts can be fit into the 6-second respawn period without affecting the rate of wires stolen. Alternatively disassembling items can also be done whilst waiting.

m.pg: Money making guide/Stealing from vegetable stalls
m.h: Vegetable Stalls can be found at the market in Lumbridge. Repeatedly steal from the stall until your inventory is full, and then bank all of your items at the nearby bank chest. It takes slightly over 1 minute to get a full inventory; about 50 runs can be completed per hour.

Bank presets are highly recommended for this method. Players can also put the unstrung bow on their action bar and assign a key bind, which can be the same button as the one for their preset. This can make the process even easier.

You can make money by casting Superheat Item on runite ore and luminite, turning it into rune bars. It's highly recommended to set up a bank preset with 13 runite ores, 13 luminite, and 13 nature runes. The preset should then be configured to be one of the two single-keypress buttons (which can be activated by pressing '1' and '2' respectively). With the addition of banks having "Load Last Preset from" by right clicking them, you can do this even more effectively. This allows players to cast superheat item almost continuously. With 57 Smithing there is a 10% chance for gaining 2 bars instead of 1 for the same amount of ore.

While it is possible to superheat over 1,815 bars in an hour, this is an incredibly click-intensive activity. To superheat even 1,716 bars in an hour requires near-undivided attention. Server latency/lag also has a significant impact on your output, as they impact the speed at which you can bank; use a world with low ping and low population count if possible.

m.pg: Money making guide/Taking eggs from larder

rq.h: Have an oak or teak larder built in your player-owned house

m.h:
Players can collect a lot of eggs from the larder in a player-owned house in a short period of time. Stand between the sink space and the larder so that the servant always returns to the same location. To collect eggs from the larder:

  1. Hold down "3"
  2. Click the larder every 1 tick (or spam click) until inventory has at least 26 eggs
  3. Call the servant for the first time (after the first inventory just click on the servant)
  4. Use an egg on the butler and type how many eggs to transfer to your bank
  5. Rinse and repeat

If the player does not have access to the mind-controlled monkey butler other servants can be used but they have to be paid once every 8 banking trips. Lower tier servants also carry fewer eggs per trip and have a longer banking time. The banking time can potentially become longer than the time needed for one to withdraw eggs from the larder.

m.t: Taking vials of water from a portable well
m.pg: Money making guide/Taking vials of water from a portable well
m.h:
Vials of water are often in high demand because they must be used with a herb in order to make an unfinished potion for the Herblore skill. Players often buy them in bulk.

A portable well can be placed next to a bank, and has a right click option to take vials of water. You then need to type the number of vials to be taken. The exact number does not need to be typed and as such typing 111 or 33 may be faster than typing 28 exactly, as any excess over the number of available inventory spaces will simply be ignored.

A bank preset with an empty inventory may be used to speed up collecting as activating the preset by hotkey will both empty the inventory of vials and close the bank interface. Using this method is is possible to obtain an inventory of vials in under 6 seconds, resulting in 16,800 vials of water per hour. This number may be higher with practice.

m.pg: Money making guide/Tanning cowhides into leather
m.h:
Soft leather is used to train Crafting in free-to-play, and it is in reasonable demand. Because it must be tanned before it can be crafted, tanning cowhide into soft leather can be quite profitable at times.

It should be noted that cowhide has a buylimit of 10,000 every 4 hours so to get this hourly profit you'll have to stack up on cowhides beforehand. It is also possible to work around the limit by directly trading with other players, or by using alternate accounts. Doing this method with 10,000 cowhides will take you around 10 minutes and net you a profit of 9550000-4420000-4740 gp. It's recommended to have at least 2210000 + 2370 gp coins for 5 minutes of this method requiring 5,000 cowhides, 1 portable crafter and 15,000 coins.

Because the price difference between hides and leather can be fairly small, it is important to buy the hides for a low price and sell the leather for a high price; you can lose out on up to 50% of the profit if you are not patient. Test the profit by buying one soft leather and one cowhide, making sure that the prices are good enough that you will make a decent profit. If you run out of cowhides, you may buy some more, but if you don't wish to spend money but you do have at least 45 Magic, you may use the Chain ability to kill more cows at once. This method makes players take less time killing cows and increases their profit per hour. Using an air mindspike or an air staff would make this process more profitable because casting air spells such as Wind Bolt or Wind Blast only requires air runes and a magic weapon.

Tanning hard leather instead is a good alternative if the price of soft leather is not high enough. While hard leather is usually more expensive (currently Hard leather 843 gp vs. Soft leather 955 gp), soft leather is often easier to sell on the Grand Exchange.

To tan soft leather with maximum efficiency, deploy a portable crafter near a bank or bank chest (for example, near the bank chest in the Lumbridge Market), make a preset with 28 cowhide, and load it. Then right-click the crafter and choose Tan Leather. Additionally, you can use portable crafters on the one already deployed to increase its duration by five minutes per crafter.

To get the fastest tanning speeds, you will need to make sure you're on the lowest ping world.

Method:

  1. Zoom in and adjust your camera so the portable crafter and the bank would be next to each other.
  2. Now load your bank preset by pressing a keybind, then instead of closing the bank interface, click on the portable.
  3. Press space, and at the same time, click on the banker.

This way you don't need to wait until the bank or tanning interface opens up and can tan with little to no delay. You should be expecting to tan 60,000 cowhides an hour however at it's peak, it is possible to tan over 6,600 cowhides per portable crafter, or nearly 80,000 per hour.

Because the price difference between hides and leather can be fairly small, it is important to buy the hides for a low price and sell the leather for a high price; you can lose out on up to 50% of the profit if you are not patient. Test the profit by buying one green dragonhide and one green dragon leather. If the difference between the two is less than 200, it may be better to tan other dragonhides instead.

It should take you around 10 minutes to tan 10,000 hides. It is recommended to have at least 2955000+2370+(5000*20) gp coins; this is the least amount of coins you need for doing this method for 5 minutes.

Then right-click the crafter and choose Tan Leather. Alternatively, you can right-click configure the portable crafter so that the default left-click action is tan hides. You can also use portable crafters on the one already deployed to increase its duration by five minutes per crafter. It is also possible to avoid the cost of the portable crafters by using those placed by other players. Fort Forinthry in World 84 almost always has a portable crafter set up next to the bank chest.

Method
  1. Zoom in and adjust your camera so the portable crafter and the bank would be next to each other.
  2. Load your bank preset by pressing a keybind, or by right-clicking the bank and selecting the 'Load Last Preset' option, then click on the portable.
  3. Press space, and at the same time, click on the banker.

This way, you do not need to wait for the bank or tanning interface to open up and can tan with little to no delay. You should expect to tan around 60,000 green dragonhides an hour. However, at its peak, it is possible to tan over 6,800 hides per portable crafter, or nearly 82,000 per hour.

Because blue dragonhide must be tanned into leather before it can be crafted, tanning the hides in bulk can be highly profitable. It should be noted that blue dragonhide has a buy limit of 10,000 hides every 4 hours. At peak efficiency, 60,000 dragonhides can be tanned in an hour, which requires stocking up beforehand but can generate a profit of 77640000-65460000-28440-(60000*20) gp coins per hour. It is also possible to work around the limit by directly trading with other players or by using alternate accounts.

Because the price difference between hides and leather can be fairly small, it is important to buy the hides for a low price and sell the leather for a high price; you can lose out on up to 50% of the profit if you are not patient. Test the profit by buying one blue dragonhide and one blue dragon leather. If the difference between the two is less than 200, it may be better to tan other dragonhides instead.

It should take you around 10 minutes to tan 10,000 hides. It is recommended to have at least 5455000+2370+(5000*20) gp coins; this is the least amount of coins you need for doing this method for 5 minutes.

To tan dragon leather with maximum efficiency, deploy a portable crafter near a bank or bank chest (for example, near one of the bank chests in Fort Forinthry), make a preset with 28 blue dragonhide, and load it. Then right-click the crafter and choose Tan Leather. Alternatively, you can right-click configure the portable crafter so that the default left-click action is tan hides. You can also use portable crafters on the one already deployed to increase its duration by five minutes per crafter. It is also possible to avoid the cost of the portable crafters by using those placed by other players. Fort Forinthry in World 84 almost always has a portable crafter set up next to the bank chest.

To get the fastest tanning speeds, you will need to make sure you're on the lowest ping world.

  2. Load your bank preset by pressing a keybind, or by right-clicking the bank and selecting the 'Load Last Preset' option, then click on the portable.
  3. Press space, and at the same time, click on the banker.

m.t: Tanning Royal dragonhide with Make Leather
m.pg: Money making guide/Tanning royal dragonhide with Make Leather

rq.nt: spell unlocked from Livid Farm (75,000 produce points)

rq.h: Lunar spellbook active

m.h:
Royal dragon leather is used to train Crafting, and it is always in high demand. Because Royal dragonhide must be tanned into leather before it can be crafted, tanning the hides in bulk can be highly profitable.

While regular tanning can be quite profitable on its own, using the lunar spell Make Leather (which tans five hides at once) can increase the profit by more than 50% while also giving decent Magic experience. The downside is that Make Leather must be unlocked from Livid Farm, which requires 75,000 produce points.

Because the price difference between hides and leather can be fairly small, it is important to buy the hides for a low price and sell the leather for a high price; you can lose out on much of the profit or even turn a loss if you are not patient. Test the profit by buying one Royal dragonhide and one Royal dragon leather. If the difference between the two is less than 200, it may be worth it to switch to a different hide type. In some cases the profit can be more than 500 coins -- the guide prices on the Grand Exchange are not always indicative of the current trading price.

Begin by equipping your staff of fire and withdrawing body runes and astral runes, along with 26 royal dragonhides. Click the Make Leather spell (either in the spellbook or directly on your action bar) and use it on one of the hides. Bank your royal dragon leather and repeat. With fast banking, one can make a total of 26,000 leathers an hour. A Large rune pouch can be used to further increase hides per hour.

When finished, sell the leather on the Grand Exchange. Since the margin can be rather high, consider buying one royal dragon leather first and selling yours for one coin below that. This can save you more than 100 coins per item.
